Learning with room to breathe

Our two-storey campus has open arched corridors, bright classrooms and green fields all around. Children are safe on campus and safe on the road, with our own school buses on every route.

From the Principal's desk

Welcome to P.R. Public School. We work every day to give each child a safe, caring and bright place to learn, from Nursery to Class 10.

Parents are always welcome to visit the school and meet our team.
